### FHN 3Q26: Reported loss on mortgage reset; core steady

**Headline:** FHN reported a GAAP diluted loss of $(0.20), versus EPS of $0.54 in 2Q26. This note discusses **adjusted EPS**, which was $0.53, down $0.01 from $0.54, a slight miss versus the prior quarter. Notable items cost $0.73 ($347m after tax). Almost all of it is the $473m pre-tax loss from moving ~$4.5bn of low-yield consumer mortgages to held-for-sale ahead of a sale that settles early in 4Q.

**EPS drivers (ex notable items):** Adjusted PPNR slipped to $362m from $364m. Adjusted fees fell $14m to $197m, mostly the deferred-comp swing (offset in expense). Adjusted provision rose to $20m from $15m, and the adjusted tax rate rose to 21.0% from 19.5%.

**Revenue and margin:** GAAP NII was $683m (+$7m). FTE NIM dipped 1bp to 3.48% as interest-bearing deposit costs rose 12bp to 2.45% on brokered carryover and client pricing; loan yields rose 6bp. Adjusted expense fell to $521m. Adjusted efficiency was 58.9%; reported efficiency was 129.6% because of the loss.

**Credit:** NCOs were $36m (22bp) versus 20bp. NPLs fell $49m to $482m. ACL/loans rose 1bp to 1.25% because the mortgages moved out of the loan base.

**Capital and returns:** CET1 fell to 10.3% from 10.5% on the notable items. TBV/share fell 5% to $13.84. Buybacks were minimal at $4m. Adjusted ROTCE was 14.4%; reported ROTCE was -5.3%.

**Guidance:** 2026 revenue is now at the low end of 3-7%. Expenses ~flat, NCOs 15-25bp. The CET1 range is cut to 10.25-10.5% from ~10.5%. Management guides the sale to +4% (~$45m) to 2027 earnings and ~150bp to ROTCE, before any redeployment.

**Thesis:** A modest positive for 2027 earnings power and the loan-to-deposit ratio (to ~88%). It costs near-term capital and buybacks, and the revenue guide was trimmed. The thesis is largely intact.
